messages.subject: AI Video Picks controlled review access request - Powermove
messages.body:
Hi Iterative Computer Team,

I'm Tom Tran, founder of AI Video Picks, an independent publication covering AI-video tools for creators and small businesses.

Powermove is relevant because its agent-in-the-loop, extension-based motion editor can render frames, make undoable timeline edits, and rewrite editor panels while the project remains editable. We have staged a controlled three-run case study, but our current Linux host cannot execute the Apple Silicon macOS build.

We are requesting official documentation, including current macOS and hardware requirements, Codex CLI and Claude Code integration details, remote-host guidance, exact current pricing and credit-consumption tables for any hosted services, supported regions, recommended settings, known limitations, watermark rules, data handling, and commercial-use terms.

We are requesting complimentary bounded review access for 60 days, ideally including a supervised or remote Apple Silicon test environment sufficient for three identical runs plus two failure/retry runs.

We are requesting complimentary rendering or API credits solely for controlled evaluation outputs, not ongoing production. If Powermove itself does not provide credits, please confirm which agent or rendering costs testers must supply.

We are requesting access to your prompt library, workflow templates, examples, recommended settings, API documentation, and known limitations.

We request approved media rights for press-kit assets, logos, screenshots, and demo clips in monetized editorial articles and videos.

We request affiliate programme details, if relevant, including signup/approval, commission, attribution, payout, Australian eligibility, and paid-search or brand-bidding restrictions.

Please provide a technical contact for reproducible failures and confirm whether Australian creators can use every advertised feature.

Access does not guarantee positive coverage. Access or credits do not guarantee coverage, a positive verdict, or ranking placement. AI Video Picks does not trade ranking placement for backlinks or inclusion elsewhere. Findings will be labelled as vendor-provided, free-trial, complimentary-access, or paid evidence as applicable. Affiliate eligibility never changes our evidence threshold.

Best,
Tom
AI Video Picks
https://aivideopicks.com
contact@aivideopicks.com
